intro.en: On steep, wet slopes the ground can move. Keeping slopes covered and water channelled, and knowing the signs, is work for every year.
intro.sw: Kwenye miteremko mikali yenye unyevu, ardhi inaweza kusogea. Kuweka miteremko ikiwa imefunikwa na maji yakielekezwa, na kujua dalili, ni kazi ya kila mwaka.

en: Know the slopes that have moved before, the years and the rains that set them off; the committee keeps the record and the map.
Know the open, flat grounds off the slopes that serve as safe places, and keep them clear.
sw: Fahamuni miteremko iliyowahi kuporomoka, miaka na mvua zilizosababisha; kamati inatunza kumbukumbu na ramani.
Fahamuni maeneo ya wazi na tambarare nje ya miteremko yanayotumika kama mahali salama, na wekeni mahali hapo wazi.

en: Keep trees and grass on the slope above and below the house; do not cut into the slope or pile soil on it.
Lead roof and yard water away from the slope in a lined channel.
Know the signs (new cracks, tilting trees or poles, muddy springs): tell the leaders and keep away when they appear.
sw: Acheni miti na nyasi kwenye mteremko juu na chini ya nyumba; msikate mteremko wala kurundika udongo juu yake.
Elekezeni maji ya paa na ya uwanja mbali na mteremko kwa mfereji uliojengwa.
Fahamuni dalili (nyufa mpya, miti au nguzo kuinama, chemchemi za tope): toeni taarifa kwa viongozi na kaeni mbali zinapoonekana.

en: Plant along the contour, keep terraces and grass strips, and leave the steepest land to trees.
sw: Pandeni kwa kufuata kontua, tunzeni matuta na mistari ya nyasi, na acheni ardhi yenye mwinuko mkali kwa miti.

who.sw: Kamati za kijiji, mtaa na kata

en: Map the slopes that have moved before and keep new houses off them; plant and protect trees on them with the residents.
sw: Chorini ramani ya miteremko iliyowahi kuporomoka na zuieni nyumba mpya juu yake; pandeni na lindeni miti huko pamoja na wakazi.

en: Keep roads and drains on slopes maintained, and mining pits and quarries drained and fenced; keep slope land out of building permits.
sw: Tunzeni barabara na mitaro kwenye miteremko, na mashimo ya migodi na machimbo yakiwa yametolewa maji na kuzungushiwa uzio; wekeni ardhi ya miteremko nje ya vibali vya ujenzi.

en: Agree a safe place off the slope and the way to it, and keep a bag with documents and medicines ready through the rains.
sw: Kubalianeni mahali salama nje ya mteremko na njia ya kufika, na wekeni mfuko wenye nyaraka na dawa tayari msimu wote wa mvua.

en: Plan the gradual move of households from the slopes that have moved before, with the land sector and the residents, and keep a response team trained for slope rescue.
sw: Pangeni uhamishaji wa taratibu wa kaya kutoka miteremko iliyowahi kuporomoka, pamoja na sekta ya ardhi na wakazi, na wekeni timu ya kukabiliana iliyofundishwa uokoaji kwenye miteremko.
